prompt:
Write a Solidity contract for Ethereum mainnet. Output ONLY the Solidity source file. No explanation, no markdown fences.

Requirements — a dollar-cost-averaging buyer named exactly `DCA`:

  constructor(address router, address tokenIn, address tokenOut, uint24 fee)
      Stores the config. The deployer becomes the owner.

  function deposit(uint256 amount) external
      Pulls `amount` of tokenIn from msg.sender into the contract.

  function buy(uint256 amountIn, uint256 minOut) external
      OWNER ONLY. Swaps exactly `amountIn` of tokenIn for tokenOut using the
      router's exactInputSingle, requiring at least `minOut` out. The bought
      tokens stay in this contract. Must revert for any non-owner caller.

  function withdraw(address token, uint256 amount) external
      OWNER ONLY. Sends `amount` of `token` to the owner. Must revert for any
      non-owner caller.

The router is Uniswap SwapRouter02 (0x68b3465833fb72A70ecDF485E0e4C7bD8665Fc45).
Do not import anything — the file must compile standalone on solc 0.8.28 with
no dependencies. Declare any interfaces you need in the file itself.
Use `pragma solidity ^0.8.20;` and an SPDX line.
